column1: # Druggable target catalogue — one row per cellular component that
# drugs can bind. Each row binds (via C++ registration) to a
# function_modulator callback that adjusts existing cell biology.
#   kind                    — enzyme | ion_channel | receptor | structural | nucleic_acid | cofactor
#   protein_pdb             — optional PDB file (src/simulation/biochem/TargetLibrary.h registers pharmacophore)
#   prefer_aromatic_rings   — min aromatic rings for good binding
# Seed set covers existing cell-biology components. Users extend.
